meta.attributionSampleNote: Sampled 17 real contacts across recent runs: attributionSource.utmMedium was 'paid' or 'paid_social' for 11/17 (~65%). Directional only, not a full census — do not treat as an exact split.
meta.vipUpgradeNote: Counted via the 'fdr masterclass - vip upgrade' tag (compound filter with each run's registered tag). This tag is legacy-named but still gets applied — however tags persist across re-registrations, so a contact who upgraded on an earlier run and later re-registers for a newer one will show as a VIP upgrade on the newer run too. Small numbers (mostly 0-2 per run) so this rarely matters, but it's not a guaranteed per-run-only count.

meta.revenueDataNote: Revenue/Deals Closed/Cash From Ads/Cash From Organic, pulled 2026-08-13T09:47:00Z, refined 2026-08-13T18:00:00Z per JV's rules: for each run, fetched the run's registered-contact emails from GHL, then joined by email against BigQuery jv-data-warehouse.freedom_academy_au.revenue_transactions (the same table backing the separate FA Revenue Dashboard — 698 rows, $795,669.01 total, synced from the CONSOLIDATED Google Sheet), FILTERED to product IN ('Accelerator','Foundation') AND closer IS NOT NULL (JV: only these products count as Masterclass-contributed revenue; unassigned-closer rows are excluded; no 'Foundation' rows exist in the data yet, filter is ready for when they do) — 218 of 698 transactions / $684,489.01 pass this filter. A transaction only counts toward a run if its date is on/after that run's date — this excludes matched buyers' pre-existing purchases from before they ever registered, which would otherwise misattribute old revenue to a run that didn't generate it. Cash From Ads vs Organic uses the same contact-level attributionSource.utmMedium signal as everything else in this app. Result: only 28 Jul 2026 has real matched revenue ($11,000, 2 deals, both Bruce Notman — a $6,000 and a $5,000 Accelerator purchase 3 days after the run); the other 5 runs are genuinely $0 under this filter (the earlier $97 'per run' figures on 4 Aug/11 Aug were '3D HT Closer Challenge' purchases, correctly excluded now — that product isn't Accelerator/Foundation). Caveats: (1) registered tags persist across re-registrations — a contact registered for two different runs would count toward both, none observed this pull; (2) most of the $795K total revenue (~$658K after the product filter) doesn't match any of the 6 runs' registrants — investigated three Aug 7-11 examples (alexanderlynne12@gmail.com, finc82@hotmail.com, bennyam4646@gmail.com) by hand: all three came through a SEPARATE, untracked Masterclass funnel ('Crypto Collective X FA Masterclass', tags 'crypto fa masterclass - registered/attended', not the per-date 'masterclass - registered D/M' scheme the 6 tracked runs use) — see oneOffEvents below, that funnel is now tracked separately. EXTENDED 2026-08-13T21:50:00Z to cover 8 more runs (26 May-24 Jun 2026, same tag scheme, same Accelerator/Foundation+closer+date-guard join). One real cross-run duplicate surfaced in this extension (previously only a theoretical caveat): Bruce Notman is tagged registered for BOTH 24 Jun (where he never attended — 0 attended that day) AND 28 Jul (where he did attend and apply) — his $6,000+$5,000 Accelerator purchase on 31 Jul lands in both runs' revenue totals as a result. Left as-is per the established per-run join logic rather than guessing which run 'deserves' the credit — but do not sum revenue across all runs and expect it to reconcile to a clean total; this $11,000 is double-counted between 24 Jun and 28 Jul specifically.
meta.oneOffEventsNote: JV's manager flagged that co-branded/collab events like 'Crypto x FA Masterclass' happen one-off, not on the recurring weekly schedule, and asked for them tracked separately rather than folded into the date selector above (they have no single 'run date' — registrations trickle in over an open window, tagged generically e.g. 'crypto fa masterclass - registered'/'attended' with no per-date suffix, confirmed via GHL's full location tag list — only one such collab scheme exists right now). Same computation as the tracked runs: registered/attended counts via GHL tag search; revenue/deals/cash-split via the same BigQuery join (Accelerator/Foundation + assigned closer + transaction date on/after each individual contact's registration date, verified by hand for all 6 matched transactions here — no pre-existing-customer leakage). Cash From Ads is $0 for Crypto x FA Masterclass because none of its matched buyers show attributionSource.utmMedium='paid' — this collab appears to be organically/community-driven (a partner audience), not Meta-ads-driven, so no Ad Spend/ROAS metric is shown for it; that's a real absence, not unfetched data. Pulled 2026-08-13T18:30:00Z.
